svg.title: Engram figure 1: anchor-protected latent memory
svg.desc: Conceptual figure, not experimental output. A static room is observed, explored, and revisited. The mechanism protects observed latent anchors, reads two spatial layers while reserving a real candidate, generates a video chunk, and filters generated memory writes using the initial-view surface. A secondary path uses latent inversion for the next chunk prefix.
svg.text: Anchor-protected latent memory for video generation
A memory loop that protects observed evidence
